Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_hierarchy to define the compound set from parent CHEMBL1422 including all salts. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary using the FAQ provenance path. Filter for target CHEMBL284 and IC50 bioactivities with nM units. Do not limit rows.
